name: nut-ai
description: Nut AI — an open-source AI photo calorie tracker that never shows a number it cannot justify.

scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json && npm --prefix apps/mobile run typecheck
scripts.build:web: cd apps/mobile && npx expo export --platform web
scripts.check:e2e: npm run build:web && npm run test:e2e
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run check:node-purity && npm run check:contrast && npm run data:verify && npm run ifct:verify && npm run indian-dishes:verify && npm run indian-dishes:verify-mappings && node scripts/audit-ingredient-density.mjs && node scripts/audit-filling-slots.mjs && node scripts/audit-duplicate-slots.mjs && node scripts/verify-composer-equivalence.mjs
scripts.data:build: node tools/nutrition-data/src/build.mjs && node tools/indian-dishes/build-sqlite.mjs && node tools/indian-dishes/curate-drafts.mjs && node tools/indian-dishes/build-sqlite.mjs
scripts.build:tools-pkgs: npm --workspace @nutai/core-schema run build && npm --workspace @nutai/db-adapter run build && npm --workspace @nutai/recipe-engine run build && npm --workspace @nutai/indian-dishes run build
